status: analysis exploration lock; not a model; no version assigned
runnerFeatureSource: 95 strict prior-date pre-race runner features including surface, distance bucket, class, venue, horse/jockey/trainer same-condition history, recent form and market residuals

ticketFeatures.win: runner feature vector + official win odds + normalized market probability + strict-OOS normal/value probabilities
ticketFeatures.pair: for each runner feature use pair mean and absolute difference; add official pair odds, normalized pair market probability, strict-OOS normal/value Harville pair probability and model-vs-market ratios

target: actual JRA return rate per 100-yen ticket; zero if ticket loses; actual payout/100 if ticket wins
objectiveSelector: per bet type, choose the fixed objective with highest Bayesian-shrunk realized return on dates strictly before current race date; cold start uses tweedie15

raceSelection.selector: expanding LightGBM Huber regression of virtual course return using prior dates only

allocation: mandatory 100 yen on the top predicted-return ticket in each required bet type, then allocate remaining 100-yen units across all three bet types by predicted ticket return multiplied by Bayesian-shrunk prior-date objective return, respecting the 10% per-ticket cap
